status_note: DRAFT, not in the evidence directory: written by the validator for use after the artifact set is committed. Admission is withheld because the raw data and the measuring code are not in the repository.

rho_reference.kind_note: tuned negation-map walk (RhoWalk::negation); prime-field curves, no Frobenius; no curve has j = 0 or 1728 (validator-checked), so no automorphism fold exists; the plain tuned walk is also measured and the best of the two is reported per price
rho_reference.unit: group operations of the arm's own group (1 GAE each) + w x native operations (IC: mul mod p, mul mod r and the recorded arms' counters; rho: canonicalisations, partition hashes, DP lookups, DP inserts, word operations). IC arms on J(C) count a Cantor step as 1 GAE although it costs 5-6 elliptic additions (best-of-N), so every IC/rho ratio is understated; the IC-above order is conservative.
rho_reference.binary_or_process: src/bin/negation_remeasure.rs: one process runs every IC arm and the rho walks of a section
rho_reference.cell: v3, p = 1619, recorded arm (all 162 arm-rows in ../validation_20261113/out/recompute_tables.json)
rho_reference.order_note: IC above the negation rho at 0, 0.1 and 1 in 156 of 162 arm-rows; the other 6 (cover first-collision arms, no native counters emitted) are unresolved lower bounds and are not ranked; no row is below.
